correctness.rationale: Gaussian STFT of two nonzero Gaussian spectral amplitudes is an exact sum of two shifted Gaussian frequency factors times phases. Modulus equality fixes one Ω; phase cancellation produces a uniform translated time lattice with spacing 1/Δ. Log ratio of iid exponential squared moduli gives Ω logistic of location μ and scale 1/(4πΔ), independent of the uniform relative phase U. Counting one translated lattice in [a,a+T) gives floor(ΔT)+Bernoulli(frac ΔT); retaining all points iff Ω belongs to J gives N=H(floor ΔT+B), independent H. Thus variance p u(1−u)+p(1−p)(ΔT)^2 and almost sure N/T→ΔH. Fresh deterministic exact STFT cancellation residual <8e−16 and high-precision logistic density integral 1 confirm normalization; the proof, not numerics, proves all parameters.

value.rationale: A sharp natural atomic-spectrum boundary case for Gaussian spectrogram zero statistics, giving full nonergodic random geometry and exact finite-window zero counts, and separating bounded full-band zero fluctuations from quadratic band-filtered variance. Offers a principled counterexample to extrapolating PSD-function mixing behavior.
